description: One series drawn as a word-sized line with no axis, no labels and no legend, for a table cell or the line beside a number. The scale is the data's own range, so it shows direction and rhythm, never magnitude, and a visually-hidden table carries every number.

labels.description: One label per point, in the order of the series' `values`. A label heads its row of the hidden table and the tooltip. A label with no value ends the line there rather than dropping it to zero.

series.description: The series drawn, exactly one. A second warns and is ignored, because a sparkline has no legend to say which line is which. `tone` is the only trend colour; without it the line takes the identity colour of the first slot, which says nothing about whether the trend is good.

label.description: Names the sparkline for its accessible name and for the caption of its data table. Required and guarded rather than defaulted: a table cell holding six sparklines needs six distinct names, and a fallback of the chart type would announce all six identically.

area.description: Fill under the line at 18% of the series colour: a tint, never a gradient. The fill reaches the floor of the box, which is the lowest value and not zero. The fill therefore shades the shape and measures nothing.

curve.description: Draw the series as a smooth curve rather than straight segments between points. The interpolation is monotone cubic, not Catmull-Rom. A Catmull-Rom curve overshoots and draws a peak or a trough nobody measured. A monotone curve stays inside the band its own two points define. The curve changes the path string and nothing else.

interactive.description: Whether the plot answers the pointer and the keyboard: one tab stop whose arrow keys move a data cursor, a crosshair, an enlarged dot and a tooltip. Off by default, because the common place of a sparkline is a table cell, where every interactive one adds a tab stop to the page. A declared boolean rather than one derived from a bound listener, because a sparkline reports nothing to listen to.

valueSuffix.description: Appended verbatim to every number the sparkline writes: the tooltip and the accessible table. Carries its own leading space if one is wanted.

valuePrefix.description: Drawn verbatim before every number the sparkline writes, as valueSuffix is drawn after it, for a currency that precedes its amount.

valueFormat.description: How each number is written before the prefix and suffix are added: which locale, how many fraction digits, whether thousands are grouped, whether large numbers are compacted. Absent, the raw JavaScript number.

height.description: The plot's height in px, the --chart-sparkline-height token by default. That token is the line box of a compact table row, so a sparkline in a cell leaves the row the height its text gives it. A number rather than a dimension string, because the sparkline does arithmetic with it to place every point.
